data.name: Ammar
data.gender_notes: Ammar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ammar is a noble Arabic name meaning 'long-lived', 'pious', or 'one who builds'. It conveys a sense of devotion, perseverance, and positive legacy. The name is associated with Ammar ibn Yasir, a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and one of the earliest Muslims. The name Ammar carries the meaning “Long-lived, Pious, Builder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Ammar usually hope their child will grow to embody long-lived, pious, builder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes resilience in faith, a builder of peace and devotion — someone who stands firm even in adversity.
data.etymology: Ammar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Long-lived, Pious, Builder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ammar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: عمار
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم يعبر عن الحياة الطويلة والصحة والرزق، مستمد من الجذر العربي عم ر التي تحمل معاني البناء والتركيب، ويُعتبر اسم عمار من الأسماء المهمة في التراث الإسلامي حيث يرتبط بالصحابي عمار بن ياسر

in_urdu.name: عمار
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام زندگی کی لمبی مدت اور صحت اور رزق کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے، جو عربي جڑ عم ر سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی بنانے اور تشکیل دینے کے ہیں، اور یہ نام اسلامي ورثے میں महत्वपور्ण ہے جہاں صحابي عمار بن ياسر سے منسلک ہے

in_hindi.name: अम्मार
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम लंबी आयु और स्वास्थ्य और रोजी की अभिव्यक्ति करता है, जो अरबी जड़ عم र से लिया गया है जिसके अर्थ निर्माण और संरचना के हैं, और यह नाम इस्लामी विरासत में महत्वपूर्ण है जहां सहाबी अम्मार बिन यासिर से जुड़ा हुआ है

in_pashto.name: عمار
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم اوږده ژوند، روغتیا او روزګار څرګندوي، چې د عربي ریښې عم ر څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د جوړولو او جوړښت په معنا دی، او دا نوم د اسلامي میراث پورې اړه لري چې صحابي عمار بن یاسر سره تړلی دی

data.cultural_impact: The name Ammar has been popular throughout history among Arab and Muslim communities due to its association with Ammar ibn Yasir, a significant figure in early Islamic history. This name represents a rich cultural heritage and strong connection to the foundational period of Islam.
data.spiritual_significance: Ammar holds deep spiritual meaning as it relates to theston of Ammar ibn Yasir, who was renowned for his unwavering faith and commitment to Islam in the face of persecution. The name is a constant reminder of the enduring spiritual qualities that Muslim communities have possessed throughout history, including faith, resilience, and piety.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Ammar in Arabic means "constant" or "permanent." In an Islamic context, it can symbolize one's unwavering commitment and dedication to the faith and righteous deeds. The person named Ammar is seen as someone who remains steadfast in his beliefs and actions, embodying the spiritual essence of resilience and consistency.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ammar ibn Yasir was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Ammar carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Ammar ibn Yasir was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad. He was one of the earliest converts to Islam and was known for his bravery and devotion. He was also a member of the Ten Promised Paradise, a group of ten companions who were promised entry into Paradise by the Prophet Muhammad.
